files.rationale: Fix the API endpoint paths to match the SRS requirements and ensure proper routing for task comments
Update the service methods to use the correct API endpoint paths that match the backend implementation

summary: The frontend is not working due to API endpoint path mismatches between the frontend service layer and backend routes. The backend routes are using incorrect paths (/api/task-comments) instead of the required paths (/api/tasks/:taskId/comments for GET/POST and /api/comments/:commentId for DELETE). This plan modifies both the backend routes and frontend service to use consistent, correct endpoint paths that match the SRS requirements.
